Package dev.px.core.event

Interface Cancellable

All Known Implementing Classes:
CancellableEvent, CharTypedEvent, ChatReceiveEvent, ChatSendEvent, EventTests.Phased, EventTests.Ping, EventTests.Pong, KeyEvent, MouseEvent, ScreenEvent, ScrollEvent, StagedEvent, TickEvent
public interface Cancellable
Implemented by events whose underlying action a handler may suppress.

Kept separate from CancellableEvent so adapters can make a third-party event type cancellable without changing its supertype.
